def process(suppression_costs) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = suppression_costs.copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['Total_numeric'] = df['Total'].str.replace('$', '').str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['Acres_numeric'] = df['Acres'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df[['Year', 'Acres_numeric', 'Total_numeric']]
input.summary: Clean suppression costs: convert Total and Acres columns to numeric values by removing $ and commas

def process(human_caused_acres) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = human_caused_acres.copy()

    df['Total_numeric'] = df['Total'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df[['Year', 'Total_numeric']]

def process(clean_suppression, clean_acres) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = clean_suppression.merge(clean_acres, on='Year', how='inner')
    merged['cost_per_acre'] = merged['Total_numeric'] / merged['Acres_numeric']
    return merged
